parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token to start the next query to retrieve more results.

> This parameter is not required for the first query. If a query does not return all results, pass the **NextToken** value from the previous response in the next query to continue.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance is located. Call the [DescribeRegions](~~426062~~) operation to get the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hitsdb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id ld-bp17j28j2y7pm0000 --next-token 212db860000 --resource-type INSTANCE --tag Value=2.2.8 Key=test --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hitsdb ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'ld-bp17j28j2y7pm0000' --Tag.1.Key test --NextToken 212db860000 --Tag.1.Value '2.2.8' --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
